generation_fit: This is fictional and symbolic UI artwork for a scripted GUI and does not depict a real person, place, event, or archival object. Built-in ImageGen is the approved source mode for this illustrated background panel.

canonical_reference.note: The canonical library has no dedicated scripted-GUI or UI-panel family. The report-art family was inspected only for subdued period paper and restrained dossier surface treatment; no vanilla art was reused.

prompt_summary: A compact flat background plate with a thin charcoal/brass outer frame, one shallow top header strip, one broad uninterrupted paper field, and one narrow bottom action strip. The center is intentionally open and quiet for parent-owned GUI overlays.

visual_notes: The center is one broad uninterrupted paper field with generous negative space.
The top treatment is a single shallow charcoal header strip with restrained brass edging.
The bottom treatment is one narrow plain action strip without button-like compartments.
The frame is restrained and low contrast; there are no slots, wells, rails, cards, portraits, people, readable words, icons, seals, emblems, grids, tactical overlays, or extra information.
The processed preview preserves the generated composition at the exact 960x640 target size.
review.visual_qa: Producer review at source and target scale found the requested compact, calm, deliberately low-information background surface.

handoff.wiring_scope: The parent agent owns .gfx and GUI wiring. Replace the existing runtime DDS at the parent_replacement_path while keeping the sprite identifier unchanged.

limitations: The package retains the runtime DDS under docs/assets only; the parent agent must copy or promote it to the parent_replacement_path during wiring.
The artwork is intentionally neutral background art. Functional text, cards, controls, and close-button surfaces remain parent-owned GUI layers.
The canonical reference root has no dedicated scripted-GUI background family, so event_art/report was used only as a restrained period-material style reference.
